integrity_notes: Analytic proofs establish the cubic Fisher coefficient and two-alternative Hellinger lower bound; the included high-precision numerical checker is supplementary. No independent scientific validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Two outcome-dependent exponential clocks, known deterministic censor deadline, independent first trajectories. No claims for general lifetime distributions, continuously renewed samples, or sufficient sample size. Local Fisher bounds require regular estimators; global Hellinger bound applies without estimator regularity. An unindexed mathematically equivalent result may exist.
title: A cubic observability barrier for censored two-channel absorption
